XRCC1.fn: Scaffold protein involved in DNA single-strand break repair by mediating the assembly of DNA break repair protein complexes. Negatively regulates ADP-ribosyltransferase activity of PARP1 during base-excision repair in order to prevent excessive PARP1 activity.

XRCC2.fn: Involved in the homologous recombination repair (HRR) pathway of double-stranded DNA, thought to repair chromosomal fragmentation, translocations and deletions. Part of the RAD51 paralog protein complex BCDX2 which acts in the BRCA1-BRCA2-dependent HR pathway.

XRCC3.fn: Involved in the homologous recombination repair (HRR) pathway of double-stranded DNA, thought to repair chromosomal fragmentation, translocations and deletions. Part of the RAD51 paralog protein complex CX3 which acts in the BRCA1-BRCA2-dependent HR pathway.

XRCC5.fn: DNA-binding protein critical for the DNA damage response, specifically in repairing double-strand breaks (DSBs) via the classical non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) pathway.

XRCC6.fn: DNA-binding protein critical for the DNA damage response, specifically in repairing double-strand breaks (DSBs) via the classical non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) pathway.

XRN1.fn: Major 5'-3' exoribonuclease involved in mRNA decay. Required for the 5'-3'-processing of the G4 tetraplex-containing DNA and RNA substrates (By similarity).

XRN2.fn: Possesses 5'->3' exoribonuclease activity (By similarity). May promote the termination of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

YAE1.fn: The complex LTO1:YAE1 functions as a target specific adapter that probably recruits apo-ABCE1 to the cytosolic iron-sulfur protein assembly (CIA) complex machinery. May be required for biogenesis of the large ribosomal subunit and initiation of translation. .

YARS2.fn: Catalyzes the attachment of tyrosine to tRNA(Tyr) in a two-step reaction: tyrosine is first activated by ATP to form Tyr-AMP and then transferred to the acceptor end of tRNA(Tyr). .

YBX1.fn: DNA- and RNA-binding protein involved in various processes, such as translational repression, RNA stabilization, mRNA splicing, DNA repair and transcription regulation.

YBX3.fn: Binds to the GM-CSF promoter. Seems to act as a repressor. Also binds to full-length mRNA and to short RNA sequences containing the consensus site 5'-UCCAUCA-3'. May have a role in translation repression (By similarity). .

YEATS2.fn: Chromatin reader component of the ATAC complex, a complex with histone acetyltransferase activity on histones H3 and H4. YEATS2 specifically recognizes and binds histone H3 crotonylated at 'Lys-27' (H3K27cr).

YEATS4.fn: Chromatin reader component of the NuA4 histone acetyltransferase (HAT) complex, a complex involved in transcriptional activation of select genes principally by acetylation of nucleosomal histones H4 and H2A.

YJEFN3.fn: May accelerate cholesterol efflux from endothelial cells to high-density lipoprotein (HDL) and thereby regulates angiogenesis.

YKT6.fn: Vesicular soluble NSF attachment protein receptor (v-SNARE) mediating vesicle docking and fusion to a specific acceptor cellular compartment.

YPEL1.fn: May play a role in epithelioid conversion of fibroblasts.

YPEL5.fn: Component of the CTLH E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex that selectively accepts ubiquitin from UBE2H and mediates ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal degradation of the transcription factor HBP1. Required for normal cell proliferation (By similarity).

YRDC.fn: Cytoplasmic and mitochondrial threonylcarbamoyl-AMP synthase required for the formation of a threonylcarbamoyl group on adenosine at position 37 (t(6)A37) in tRNAs that read codons beginning with adenine.

YTHDC1.fn: Regulator of alternative splicing that specifically recognizes and binds N6-methyladenosine (m6A)-containing RNAs.

YY1.fn: Multifunctional transcription factor that exhibits positive and negative control on a large number of cellular and viral genes by binding to sites overlapping the transcription start site.

ZBTB11.protein: Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 11
ZBTB11.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation. .

ZBTB14.protein: Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 14
ZBTB14.fn: Transcriptional activator of the dopamine transporter (DAT), binding its promoter at the consensus sequence 5'-CCTGCACAGTTCACGGA-3'. Binds to 5'-d(GCC)(n)-3' trinucleotide repeats in promoter regions and acts as a repressor of the FMR1 gene.

ZBTB17.protein: Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 17
ZBTB17.fn: Transcription factor that can function as an activator or repressor depending on its binding partners, and by targeting negative regulators of cell cycle progression.

ZBTB4.protein: Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 4
ZBTB4.fn: Transcriptional repressor with bimodal DNA-binding specificity. Represses transcription in a methyl-CpG-dependent manner.

ZBTB44.protein: Zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 44
ZBTB44.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation. .

ZC3H13.fn: Associated component of the WMM complex, a complex that mediates N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methylation of RNAs, a modification that plays a role in the efficiency of mRNA splicing and RNA processing.

ZC3H3.fn: Required for the export of polyadenylated mRNAs from the nucleus. Enhances ACVR1B-induced SMAD-dependent transcription. Binds to single-stranded DNA but not to double-stranded DNA in vitro. Involved in RNA cleavage (By similarity). .

ZC3H4.fn: RNA-binding protein that suppresses transcription of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs). LncRNAs are defined as transcripts more than 200 nucleotides that are not translated into protein.

ZC3H8.fn: Acts as a transcriptional repressor of the GATA3 promoter. Sequence-specific DNA-binding factor that binds to the 5'-AGGTCTC-3' sequence within the negative cis-acting element intronic regulatory region (IRR) of the GATA3 gene (By similarity).

ZCCHC9.fn: May down-regulate transcription mediated by NF-kappa-B and the serum response element. .

ZCRB1.protein: Zinc finger CCHC-type and RNA-binding motif-containing protein 1

ZDHHC7.fn: Golgi-localized palmitoyltransferase that catalyzes the addition of palmitate onto various protein substrates and therefore functions in several unrelated biological processes.

ZFC3H1.fn: Subunit of the trimeric poly(A) tail exosome targeting (PAXT) complex, a complex that directs a subset of long and polyadenylated poly(A) RNAs for exosomal degradation. The RNA exosome is fundamental for the degradation of RNA in eukaryotic nuclei.

ZFP69B.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation. Essential for Golgi structural integrity. .

ZFR.fn: Involved in postimplantation and gastrulation stages of development. Involved in the nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of STAU2. Binds to DNA and RNA (By similarity). .

ZMAT2.fn: Involved in pre-mRNA splicing as a component of the spliceosome. .

ZMYM4.fn: Required for regulation of cell morphology and cytoskeletal organization. .

ZNF100.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF133.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation as a repressor.

ZNF143.fn: Transcription factor that activates expression of genes transcribed by both RNA polymerases II and III, and which is required to safeguard mitochondrial activity.

ZNF207.protein: BUB3-interacting and GLEBS motif-containing protein ZNF207
ZNF207.fn: Kinetochore- and microtubule-binding protein that plays a key role in spindle assembly. ZNF207/BuGZ is mainly composed of disordered low-complexity regions and undergoes phase transition or coacervation to form temperature-dependent liquid droplets.

ZNF236.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF24.fn: Transcription factor required for myelination of differentiated oligodendrocytes. Required for the conversion of oligodendrocytes from the premyelinating to the myelinating state.

ZNF253.fn: May function as a transcription factor. Seem to have a transcriptional repression activity.

ZNF284.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF292.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF317.fn: May function as a transcription factor. May play an important role in erythroid maturation and lymphoid proliferation.

ZNF335.fn: Component or associated component of some histone methyltransferase complexes may regulate transcription through recruitment of those complexes on gene promoters. Enhances ligand-dependent transcriptional activation by nuclear hormone receptors.

ZNF407.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF468.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF492.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF506.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF559.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF574.fn: Part of a ribosome quality control that mediates surveillance of ribosome assembly and promotes degradation of ribosomes with assembly defects. .

ZNF658.fn: Mediates transcriptional repression in response to zinc.

ZNF674.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF676.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF687.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF706.fn: Transcription repressor involved in the exit of embryonic stem cells (ESCs) from self-renewal (By similarity). Acts by repressing expression of KLF4 (By similarity). Required for Wnt signaling activation. .

ZNF718.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF763.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF787.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNF830.fn: May play a role in pre-mRNA splicing as component of the spliceosome. Acts as an important regulator of the cell cycle that participates in the maintenance of genome integrity.

ZNF84.fn: May be involved in transcriptional regulation.

ZNHIT1.fn: Plays a role in chromatin remodeling by promoting the incorporation of histone variant H2AZ1/H2A.Z into the genome to regulate gene expression.

ZNHIT2.fn: May act as a bridging factor mediating the interaction between the R2TP/Prefoldin-like (R2TP/PFDL) complex and U5 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U5 snRNP).

ZNHIT6.fn: Required for box C/D snoRNAs accumulation involved in snoRNA processing, snoRNA transport to the nucleolus and ribosome biogenesis. .

ZRANB2.fn: Splice factor required for alternative splicing of TRA2B/SFRS10 transcripts. Binds to ssRNA containing the consensus sequence 5'-AGGUAA-3'. May interfere with constitutive 5'-splice site selection. .

ZRSR2.protein: U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein auxiliary factor 35 kDa subunit-related protein 2
ZRSR2.fn: Pre-mRNA-binding protein required for splicing of both U2- and U12-type introns. Selectively interacts with the 3'-splice site of U2- and U12-type pre-mRNAs and promotes different steps in U2 and U12 intron splicing.

ZW10.fn: Essential component of the mitotic checkpoint, which prevents cells from prematurely exiting mitosis. Required for the assembly of the dynein-dynactin and MAD1-MAD2 complexes onto kinetochores.

ZWINT.protein: Outer kinetochore KNL1 complex subunit ZWINT
ZWINT.fn: Acts as a component of the outer kinetochore KNL1 complex that serves as a docking point for spindle assembly checkpoint components and mediates microtubule-kinetochore interactions.
